summary.t: FOLKSOM AS is a private limited company in Tønsberg, founded in 1992, working in other real estate activities on a fee or contract basis (industry code 68.320).
On its own website (folksom.no) it describes itself as: "FOLKSOM er en ledende utvikler og forvalter av næringseiendom, bolig og stedsutviklingsprosjekter i Vestfoldregionen".
The general manager (daglig leder) is Pål Grabow Bakke Egeland.

Its 2025 accounts show revenue of NOK 5.2 million (down NOK 2.1 million, -28% on 2024), an operating loss of NOK 7.2 million and a net loss of NOK 5.6 million (against a loss of NOK 16.4 million in 2024).
Latest dated event: auditor registration changed (2026-10-05).
Online: website folksom.no, 3 social profiles and 13 dated news items; not found: job ads.

s.t: FOLKSOM AS is a private limited company in Tønsberg, founded in 1992, working in other real estate activities on a fee or contract basis (industry code 68.320).
On its own website (folksom.no) it describes itself as: "FOLKSOM er en ledende utvikler og forvalter av næringseiendom, bolig og stedsutviklingsprosjekter i Vestfoldregionen".
The register states its activity (in Norwegian) as: "Forvalte, utvikle og realisere egen eiendomsportefølje".
The general manager (daglig leder) is Pål Grabow Bakke Egeland.
The board is chaired by Terje Nesbakken.
The board has 3 members including the chair; the others are Kristian Gjertsen Lundkvist and Fredrik Røed.
It owns 8 registered subsidiaries: STORGATEN 51 TØNSBERG AS, FOLKSOM BOLIG AS, SMIDSRØDVEIEN 6 AS and 5 more.
Auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS.

sections.q: How big is it and how is it doing?

s.t: Its 2025 accounts show revenue of NOK 5.2 million (down NOK 2.1 million, -28% on 2024), an operating loss of NOK 7.2 million and a net loss of NOK 5.6 million (against a loss of NOK 16.4 million in 2024).
Equity was NOK 156.0 million at the end of 2025 (down NOK 5.6 million on 2024), 54% of total assets of NOK 286.9 million; this equity ratio is computed from the filed figures.

Its 2025 group (consolidated) accounts show revenue of NOK 18.7 million (down NOK 11.3 million, -38% on 2024), an operating loss of NOK 13.3 million and a net loss of NOK 31.6 million (against a loss of NOK 30.7 million in 2024).
Equity was NOK 72.4 million at the end of 2025 (down NOK 31.6 million on 2024), 22% of total assets of NOK 328.3 million; this equity ratio is computed from the filed figures.
It has 9 employees in the Entity Register (as of 2024-06-12) and 1 registered workplace in Tønsberg.
This is the first run for this company, so there is no earlier snapshot to compare with; later runs report changes against it.

Most recent dated events: 2026-10-05 auditor registration changed; 2026-07-28 Entity Register record updated; 2026-04-30 news on its website: "Tone fant sitt nye hjem på Tolvsrød torg"; 2025-12-31 financial year 2025 ended (latest filed accounts); 2025-12-03 news on its website: "Blomsterkasser på plass på Tolvsrød torg".
